bugs.title: ConfigStore NameError in event_stream()
bugs.description: ConfigStore import was function-local in _handle_chat, get_config, save_config but not in event_stream. Silent NameError in event_stream -> loaded_config=None -> fallback to _agent.provider with api_key=None -> Authorization: Bearer None -> 401 Authentication Failed.

bugs.title: OpenAIProvider sends 'Bearer None' header
bugs.description: When config.api_key is None, f"Bearer {config.api_key}" produces 'Bearer None' string. httpx sends this invalid Authorization header -> scnet returns 401.

bugs.title: Empty string overwrites config values from DB
bugs.description: Frontend sends empty strings for optional config fields. Config.from_dict and Config.merge treated empty strings as valid values, overwriting existing DB config with empty values.

bugs.title: test_race_conditions.py incompatible with pytest
bugs.description: File uses TestResults class with __init__ (pytest ignores classes with __init__), functions take 'results' param (no fixture exists), and requires running server at localhost:8000. Not designed as pytest tests. 10 errors in test suite.
